en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a riverside steamship landing. In the foreground is a small wooden pier or pontoon with a hut and several men standing around. A sign on the hut reads "Strehla". To the right, a paddle steamer is arriving or departing on the river. In the background, across the river, are trees and buildings of a small town, including a church tower. At the top of the card is printed the German caption "Strehla a. Elbe — Dampfschiffhaltstelle".
